    No, all Kohl's locations will be closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026
    . The retailer treats Easter as a full shutdown, joining Thanksgiving and Christmas as one of three annual holidays where all stores are closed to give employees the day off. 
    Key details regarding the Easter holiday: 
    • Store Closures: All 1,100+ Kohl's locations will be closed on April 5, 2026.
    • Online Shopping: You can still shop on Kohls.com and the Kohl's App during the closure.
    • Alternative Retailers: For those needing to shop in person, other major retailers like Target and Costco are also closed, but Walmart is expected to be open. 
    Check your local store's regular hours for the days before or after the holiday via the Kohl's store locator.

    AI Overview
    Many major retailers, including
    Target, Costco, Aldi, Publix, and Lowe's, will be closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026, to allow employees to observe the holiday. Other closures include Best Buy, Macy's, Kohl's, Sam's Club, and various clothing retailers. 
    Key Stores Closed on Easter Sunday 2026 
    • Retail/Department Stores: Target, Best Buy, Kohl's, Macy's, TJ Maxx, Marshalls, HomeGoods, Nordstrom/Nordstrom Rack, JCPenney, Burlington, Dick's Sporting Goods.
    • Grocery Stores: Aldi, Publix, H-E-B, Natural Grocers, and many local independent grocers.
    • Wholesale Clubs: Costco and Sam's Club.
    • Home Improvement: Lowe's, The Container Store.
    • Other: Hobby Lobby, Michaels, Apple, Office Depot/OfficeMax. 
    Stores Remaining Open (Often with Reduced Hours) 
    • Grocery/Retail: Walmart, Whole Foods, Trader Joe's, BJ's Wholesale, Sprouts, Winn-Dixie.
    • Pharmacy: CVS and Walgreens (often with reduced hours). 
    It is highly recommended to check with your local store branch as hours can vary.
